# Query Monitor

Contributors: johnbillion
Tags: debug, debug-bar, development, performance, query monitor
Tested up to: 7.0
Stable tag: 4.0.7
License: GPL v2 or later
Donate link: https://github.com/sponsors/johnbillion

Query Monitor is the developer tools panel for WordPress and WooCommerce.

## Description

Query Monitor enables debugging of database queries, PHP errors, hooks and actions, block editor blocks, enqueued scripts and stylesheets, HTTP API calls, and more.

### Browser extension

Adds a panel to your browser's developer tools.

## Screenshots

1. The admin toolbar menu item.
2. The overview panel.

## Frequently Asked Questions

### Does this plugin work with PHP 8?

Yes, it does.

On GitHub.
